tagline: Blobs is mobile app with a Tamagotchi-like NFT that lives inside your phone! You take care of it by walking it every day.
description:
Blobs is mobile app with a Tamagotchi-like NFT that lives inside your phone! You take care of it by walking it every day.

We run weekly lotteries and give out prizes every week! Download and try out our app on TestFlight today.

This project is an iOS mobile app. We allow you to save your tamagotchi-like Blob as an NFT on your favorite blockchain.
how_its_made:
This project is an iOS mobile app built in React Native and ethers.js. We allow you to save your tamagotchi-like Blob as an NFT on your favorite blockchain.

Supported blockchains include:
- Polygon
- Optimism 
- Mina
- EVMOS
- Near
- SKALE
- FUEL
- Gnosis Chain
- EY OpsChain

Roadmap includes integrations with:
- XMTP for P2P messaging
- Lens Protocol for P2P following
- 0x to BlobCoin liquidity
